notes: Addresses and policy IDs inferred from decoded transaction CBORs
Updated from CBOR analysis - addresses now match current preprod deployment

index-policy.description: Mints access tokens and index tokens

course-governance-policy.description: Mints course governance tokens (token name = courseId)
course-governance-policy.tokenNaming: Token name is the course NFT policy ID (courseId)

local-state-nft-policy.description: Mints LocalStateNFT - CRITICAL: This policy ID IS the courseId
local-state-nft-policy.designNote: The LocalStateNFT minting policy ID doubles as the course identifier (courseId). This is a critical design feature - the courseId is not a separate token but the policy that mints the course's LocalStateNFT.

module-policy.description: Mints module tokens - token name is hash of SLT list
module-policy.tokenNaming: Token name is 32-byte hash of the module's SLT strings

course-state-policy.description: Mints course state tokens for student enrollment - different policy ID for each course
course-state-policy.tokenNaming: Token name is student alias (ensures one enrollment per student per course)
course-state-policy.redeemerSchema: Constructor 0 = mint (enroll with optional commitment), Constructor 4 = burn (credential claim with completed_modules verification)
course-state-policy.designNote: Each course has its own course-state-policy. The policy is parameterized by the course's LocalStateNFT (courseId). Students minting a course-state token are essentially enrolling in that specific course.

treasury-script-policy.description: Mints TreasuryScriptV2 token for project treasury setup

project-state-policy.description: Mints project state tokens - token name is stake credential hash
project-state-policy.tokenNaming: Token name is stake credential hash (registered on creation)

treasury-token-policy.description: Mints treasury tokens held in treasury-validator

contributor-state-policy.description: Mints contributor state tokens for project enrollment - different policy per project
contributor-state-policy.tokenNaming: Token name is contributor alias (ensures one enrollment per contributor per project)
contributor-state-policy.redeemerSchema: Constructor 0 = mint (enroll with task commitment), Constructor 3 = burn (credential claim with completed tasks proof)
contributor-state-policy.designNote: Each project has its own contributor-state-policy. The mint redeemer includes prerequisite proof (list of courseId + completed SLTs). Similar pattern to course-state-policy for courses.

index-validator.description: Index linked list validator - holds index tokens with {prev_alias, next_alias} datum

global-state-v2.description: Global State V2 validator - holds g-prefixed token with {alias, local_state_information} datum
global-state-v2.redeemerSchema: Constructor 0 = enrollment (flag=-1), Constructor 1 = credential claim (flag=0, includes policy_id, state_policy, credential_hash)

local-state-token-validator.description: Holds LocalStateToken with {courseId} datum AND embedded course validator script_ref
local-state-token-validator.designNote: Courses carry their own validator as an embedded script reference. This allows course-specific validation logic.

course-governance-validator.description: Holds governance token with {participants: [aliases]} datum - SHARED between courses (teachers) and projects (managers)

module-validator.description: Holds module tokens with {courseId, allowed_course_state_ids, prereq_slt_hashes} datum

course-state-validator.description: Holds student course state tokens with assignment commitment data
course-state-validator.datumSchema: Constructor 0 = no active commitment (completed_modules list), Constructor 1 = has active commitment (slt_hash, assignment_info, completed_modules)
course-state-validator.redeemerSchema: Constructor 0 = student action, Constructor 1 = student update (slt_hash + new assignment_info), Constructor 2 = teacher assess (with teacher_alias), Constructor 3 = claim credential (empty)

treasury-script-validator.description: Holds TreasuryScriptV2 token with {projectId} datum and embedded treasury validator script_ref

project-state-validator.description: Holds project state token with {projectId, blacklist, metadata} datum
project-state-validator.datumSchema: Constructor 0: [projectId (bytes), blacklist (list of alias bytes), metadata (bytes)]
project-state-validator.redeemerSchema: Constructor 0 = empty redeemer (action validated by observer)

treasury-validator.description: Holds project treasury funds with treasury token

task-escrow-validator.description: Holds task escrow UTxOs and treasury deposits for task operations
task-escrow-validator.note: Treasury-token name = contributor_state_id (prerequisite policy ID). Address varies per project - same stake credential but different payment credentials.

contributor-state-validator.description: Holds contributor state tokens with task commitment data
contributor-state-validator.datumSchema: Constructor 0 = no active commitment (completed_tasks list), Constructor 1 = has active commitment (task_definition, task_info, completed_tasks)
contributor-state-validator.redeemerSchema: Constructor 0 = contributor action, Constructor 1 = update, Constructor 2 = assess (manager), Constructor 3 = claim/burn
contributor-state-validator.designNote: Each project has its own contributor-state-validator. Similar pattern to course-state-validator for courses. Token name = contributor alias.

index-observer.description: Observer for index operations - receives alias as redeemer

course-observer.description: Observer for course operations - receives list of tx output refs as redeemer

project-observer.description: Observer for project creation - receives tx output ref as redeemer

project-prereq-observer.description: Validates course prerequisites - receives {output_refs, course_prereqs_map} as redeemer

project-state-observer.description: Validates project state updates (blacklist, etc.) - receives {projectId, stakeCredHash} as redeemer

task-escrow-observer.description: Validates task add/remove operations - receives task parameters and manager alias
task-escrow-observer.redeemerSchema: Constructor 1 (add): [tasks_list, alias]; tasks have [content, expiration, lovelace, native_assets]

task-commit-observer.redeemerSchema: Constructor 0: [alias, task_definition, empty_list, task_info]; task_definition has [project_content, expiration_time, lovelace_amount, native_assets]
task-commit-observer.note: Different observer from task-escrow-observer - this validates contributor commits, not manager task management

task-assess-observer.redeemerSchema: Constructor 1: [stakeCredHash, projectId, managerAlias, decisions_list]; decisions have [contributor_state_id, contributor_alias, outcome]
task-assess-observer.note: Manager assesses contributor task submissions - similar to course.teacher.assignments.assess

protocol-treasury.description: Treasury for access token minting (5 ADA)

instance-treasury.description: Instance treasury for course and project operations
instance-treasury.designNote: Instance-specific treasury. Course and project creation fees scale with number of teachers/managers (100 ADA base + 10 ADA each). Update operations are flat 10 ADA. UPCOMING: First teacher/manager will be free.

f7d56e16391931b31e79abf4b679a70154b0a175.note: Each course has its own LocalStateToken that embeds the course-specific validator

2ac1be2d55cf5097eaa1b24d871c60bbbeb178b7.note: Each course has its own LocalStateToken that embeds the course-specific validator
